    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    walls_c = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + walls_r + [h]

        row=[]
        for c,d in zip(cb,cb[1:]):
            cell=[grid[r][j] for r in range(a+1,b) for j in range(c+1,d)]
            row.append(1 if special in cell else base)
        out.append(row)
    return out
